text: Tutoring | Academic Assistance | College of Staten Island Website Skip to main content Tutoring Prev Next Additional Navigation Close The College of Staten Island offers free one-on-one and group tutoring, supplemental instruction, and academic workshops to all students. Professional and peer tutors are available to support you, keep you on track, and help you achieve your goals. Our Tutoring and Learning Centers work closely with academic and administrative departments to guide students on their path to academic success. Office of Academic Support Tutoring Center, 1L-117 Office of Academic Support (OAS) The Office of Academic Support (OAS) is committed to helping all students achieve academic success by providing high-quality and comprehensive tutoring across a wide range of subjects. Our team of professionally trained peer tutors is available every day of the week, offering both walk-in and scheduled appointments. Location : Library (Room 1L-117) Tutoring Option: One-on-One, Small Group, and workshops Meeting Type: In-person and online (appointments and walk-ins) Visit The Office of Academic Support Computer Science Tutoring Lab, 1N-113 Computer Science Tutoring The Computer Science Tutoring Lab provides tutoring for all undergraduate computer science courses. Tutors can assist students with understanding computer science concepts, as well as completing and debugging programming and application assignments. Location : Room 1N-113 Tutoring Option: One-on-One and Small Group Meeting Type: In-person and Online (appointments and walk-ins) Visit the Computer Science Tutoring Lab in room 1N-113 The Computer Science Tutoring Schedule Math Tutorial Laboratory, 1S-214 Math Tutorial Laboratory The Math Tutorial Laboratory offers a supportive environment for studying mathematics. It is open to all students currently enrolled in math courses at CSI. Professional tutors and faculty from the Math Department are available to assist with 100- and 200-level math courses. Location : Room 1S-214 Tutoring Option: One-to-One and Small Group Meeting Type: In-person (walk-ins) Visit the Math Tutorial Laboratory in Room 1S-214 Media Culture Tutoring Lab 1P-122 (Film & Video), 1P-231 (Digital Communications) Media Culture Tutoring The Media Culture Department offers study sessions designed for students enrolled in cinema and communications courses. The sessions are designed to bridge the gap between the theory and application of professional production techniques by helping students become more familiar with the equipment and applications introduced in their classes. Location : Room 1P-122 and 1P-231 Tutoring Option: One-on-One and Small Group Meeting Type: In-person (walk-ins) Visit the Media Culture Tutoring Center in Rooms 1P-122 and 1P-231 Modern Languages Media Center, 2S-114 The Modern Languages Media Center The Modern Languages Media Center at CSI offers free, drop-in tutoring available both over Zoom and in-person for Spanish, Italian, French, ASL, Chinese and Arabic. The Center also offers a range of audio/visual equipment, multimedia computers, and word processing programs to support the teaching and learning of foreign languages. Location : Room 2S-114 Tutoring Option: One-to-One and Small Group Meeting Type: In-person (walk-ins) Visit the Modern Languages Media Center The Nursing Neighborhood The Nursing Neighborhood The Nursing Student Resource and Nursing Student Test Prep Centers offer free peer mentor-tutoring and success coaching for nursing students. The “Neighborhood” promotes professional socialization, satisfaction, positive academic outcomes, persistence, and stress reduction. Location : Room 5S-11 and 5S-121 Tutoring Option: Peer-Mentoring and Small Group Meeting Type: In-person (walk-ins) Visit the Nursing Neighborhood SEEK Learning Center for Academic Support, 1A-108 The SEEK Learning Center The SEEK Learning Center is an exclusive resource designed to support SEEK students in enhancing their academic skills. The Center provides a welcoming environment where students can access personalized academic support from a team of experienced tutors and staff in a wide range of subjects. Location : Room 1A-108 Tutoring Option: One-on-One, Small Groups, and Workshops Meeting Type: In-person and online (appointments and walk-ins) Visit the SEEK Learning Center The Writing Center, 2S-216 The Writing Center The Writing Center is dedicated to supporting students at any stage of the writing process, no matter the subject. Whether you are brainstorming ideas, drafting, or refining your final piece, our goal is to help you think critically about your writing and develop your skills, not just correct errors. Our services provide constructive feedback, answer your questions, and help you refine your unique voice. Location : Room 2S-216 Tutoring Option: One-on-One Meeting Type: In-person and online (appointments and walk-ins) Visit the Writing Center
